reuse.why: Adds the template rule to the existing shouldFillCategory/getFillCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses, and switches setZero to the existing 'skip' hidden rule.

duplication.why: The template check is written once in the shared predicate; the two queries only add the goal_def column.

placement.why: The rule sits in the selection block that budget/actions.ts documents as the single definition of which categories a month-wide action fills.

scope.why: Only the rule, the two column additions, the setZero hidden-rule fix and a test.

maintainability.why: Future exclusion rules have an obvious single home, and hasSavedTemplates is small and documented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (filterFillCategories) and setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg (getFillCategories) all go through shouldFillCategory.

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used via filterFillCategories/getFillCategories by every month-wide action.
